payload.blocks: Phase 8 (delete the dead source) cannot land, and phases 11 and 10 wait on it.
payload.headline: Phase 8 land fails doc-health: 38 docs link to the deleted files, 17 of them outside the footprint

parts.cause: The plan ordered phase 8 before phase 9 and assumed docs only name deleted files as text. Many docs link to them, and doc-health checks every platform doc, including the history subtrees the plan's non-goals said to leave as written. Phase 9 is also still waiting on running plan 261124-0004, which owns docs/platform/run-supervisor/spec.md (3 of the broken links).

options.cost: One small unit and one land; about 30 minutes.
options.does: Widen the footprint and phase 8 by the 17 docs. One unit on p08 turns each link to a deleted file into plain code text (or points it at the Rust owner) in all 38 docs, with no other wording change. The 3 links in run-supervisor/spec.md are made by 261124-0004's lead or by this lead with that plan's consent. Phase 9 keeps its prose rewrites.
options.gain: Phase 8 lands as soon as run-supervisor/spec.md is settled; the history docs change by link syntax only.
options.harm: History records get a minimal link edit, and phase 8 touches one doc another plan owns.
options.label: Link-only fix inside phase 8

options.cost: No extra unit, but an open-ended wait.
options.does: Widen the footprint by the 17 docs and add them to phase 9; make phase 8 depend on phase 9. Phase 9 runs after 261124-0004 lands.
options.gain: Each doc is edited once, by the docs phase, in full.
options.harm: Phase 8, 11 and 10 wait for 261124-0004 to finish, for an unknown time.
options.label: Phase 8 waits for phase 9

options.cost: A separate item with its own owner.
options.does: Change doc-health so history subtrees may link to missing files; fix only the 21 live docs.
options.harm: Adds a rule exception (a new mechanism, against RUL104) outside this plan.
options.label: Exempt history docs in doc-health

parts.recommendation: Link-only fix inside phase 8: it unblocks the deletion now and changes history docs only in link syntax.

scope.allows: Widening this plan's footprint by the 17 named docs and making link-only edits there and in the 21 phase-9 docs; editing the 3 links in docs/platform/run-supervisor/spec.md once 261124-0004 agrees.
scope.forbids: Any prose rewrite of the history docs, any doc-health rule change, and any other edit to a file of 261124-0004.

parts.what: The land of branch delete-dead-node-execution-closure/p08 failed one test, the doc-health live self-check: 38 platform docs link to now-deleted files. 21 are in phase 9's footprint; 17 are outside the plan footprint (agent-coordination README, vision, architecture/*, vocabulary/*, verification/*, proposals/README; platform README and vision; two proposals; system-architecture/architecture/*; host-invocation-routing legacy-cli-transition). All else is green; review blockers fixed.
